en.bridge.label: Prediction bridge
en.completion.toggle: History completion: ghost the rest of the matching history prompt while typing; accept with Tab or →
en.history.global: Cross-session history: Up/Down history persists across sessions (browser-local, capped at 200)
en.paste.toggle: Right-click pastes directly: right-click the input box to paste (terminal style, no context menu)
en.settings.note: History (Up/Down, prefix search, Ctrl+R) is always on. Settings are browser-local and take effect immediately.
en.settings.title: >_ Terminal Input
en.sideChat.askHint: Quote moved into the side chat — type your question
en.sideChat.disabledHint: Side chat is off: Settings → Terminal input → Side chat (experimental)
en.sideChat.empty: No side threads yet: create one to work in parallel with the main conversation (same workspace, file writes allowed)
en.sideChat.guardClash: Both sides touched these files — mind the overwrite:
en.sideChat.guardParallel: The main chat and a side thread are running at once: avoid editing the same file from both.
en.sideChat.guardToggle: Warn about parallel writes (reminder only, never blocks)
en.sideChat.guideDesc: A second thread working in parallel with the main chat (same workspace)
en.sideChat.input: Send an instruction to this thread… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks)
en.sideChat.note: Note: the side chat shares this workspace — avoid editing the same file from both sides at once.
en.sideChat.placeholder: Side-chat panel is wired up (message stream and composer are being implemented)
en.sideChat.title: Side chat
en.sideChat.toggle: Enable side chat: run a second thread in the right sidebar / split / floating panel, in parallel with the main conversation (same workspace, file writes allowed)
en.suggest.keys: Keys: Tab or → accepts a completion/prediction · Ctrl+R reverse search · Ctrl+Shift+Space predicts now
en.suggest.toggle: Context prediction: with an empty composer, predict your next prompt with the current session model; accept with Tab or → (once per turn, small quota use)
en.toc.title: Conversation TOC
en.toc.toggle: Chat TOC: show the draggable grip on the chat left edge
